sources.title: Electrolux Professional 900XP two wells electric fryer 23 liter spec sheet (391385 / 391338)

summary: The Electrolux Professional 900XP twin-well electric fryer (391338) has two 23 litre V-shaped wells heated by external infrared elements, 36 kW in total on a three-phase supply. It is supplied with four half-size baskets and cupboard doors. Suits busy restaurants and canteens frying large volumes.

highlights.text: External infrared elements with deflectors for easier well cleaning
Thermostat range 105-185 °C with overheat protection
IPX5 water resistance; control knobs sealed against water
Oil drains via tap into a container under the wells

facts.label: Wells
facts.value: 2 'V' shaped wells with external heating elements

facts.label: Heating elements
facts.value: High efficiency external infrared elements (36 kW) with deflectors on the outside of the well

facts.label: Feet
facts.value: Four 50 mm stainless steel legs as standard (height adjustable)

facts.label: Worktop / panels
facts.value: Worktop in 20/10 stainless steel; exterior panels stainless steel with Scotch Brite finish

facts.label: Oil drain
facts.value: Tap into container under the wells

facts.label: Clearance to sensitive surfaces
facts.value: Safety gap of approx. 150 mm or heat insulation

facts.label: Baskets supplied
facts.value: 4 half size baskets (2 x pack of 2 half size baskets for 18/23 lt fryers, PNC 927223)

facts.label: Doors supplied
facts.value: 2 x door for open base cupboard (PNC 206350)

images.alt: Electrolux Professional 900XP twin tank electric fryer 391338

notes: Sheet covers 391385 and 391338; only 391338 values used. External width/height not on the sheet, so Caterkwik 800 x 930 x 908 is unverified. Sheet gives no amps (Caterkwik 90 A), filtration or cold zone; Caterkwik says 3 baskets but the sheet says 4 half-size baskets. Warranty not stated.

sources.title: Electrolux Professional 700XP two wells freestanding gas fryer 15 liter spec sheet (371071)
Electrolux Professional 700XP Two Wells Freestanding Gas Fryer 15 liter (COD 371071)

summary: The Electrolux Professional 700XP freestanding gas fryer (371071) has two 15 litre V-shaped wells with four 7 kW burners, 28 kW gas in total, supplied for natural gas with LPG conversion jets. It comes with two full-size baskets and cupboard doors. Suits restaurants and takeaways frying in volume.

highlights.text: Four 7 kW stainless steel burners, flame failure device on each
Thermostat range 105-185 °C with overheat protection
Piezo spark ignition; natural gas or LPG with conversion jets supplied
Oil drains through a tap into a container under the well
